hypothesis: tornado.escape.xhtml_escape does not escape single quotes, so a single-quoted HTML attribute containing user input can be broken out of, causing XSS.
trigger: Call tornado.escape.xhtml_escape("'") and assert the result contains ''' (or at least does not contain a raw single quote).
potential_failure: xhtml_escape returns the raw single quote unchanged, leaving single-quoted attributes vulnerable to injection.

oracle.expected_behavior: xhtml_escape should escape single quotes as ' so that values are safe in both single- and double-quoted HTML attributes.
oracle.target_evidence: tornado/escape.py defines xhtml_escape with a translation table that maps &, <, >, ", and ' to entities; the docstring says it escapes HTML special characters. The ordinary test tornado/test/escape_test.py includes xhtml_escape tests for &, <, >, and " but not for single quotes, leaving the behavior unverified.
